Scrap Squall.name: Scrap Squall
Scrap Squall.description: The user lifts every loose bolt, coin, nail and scrap of steel nearby into a whirling cloud and flings it flat-side first through a cone across a room. Everyone in the cone takes bludgeoning damage and, battered from all sides, cannot aim a weapon or a Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: moderate.
